extracted.intended_audience: PR and communications professionals, corporate marketing teams, and organizations (from Fortune 500 to startups/small businesses) seeking multimedia press-release production and distribution
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for producing and amplifying press releases with multimedia (video, audio, images, interactive content) and for selecting distribution/packaging options (Multichannel News Release variants, virtual media tours, social/video distribution).

rubrics_metrics.name: Compelling, engaging, unforgettable content
rubrics_metrics.description: "Tell your story with compelling, engaging, unforgettable content"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use live-action footage, 2D/3D animation, infographics, motion graphics and other media to make the story memorable and emotionally/visually engaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: High-quality video and animation production
rubrics_metrics.description: "Video and animation have proven power to increase audience engagement, lead generation and sales."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce professional, high-quality video (animated explainer to live-action documentary), whether a single promotional video or a full video library; outsourcing to an experienced production team if in-house resources are limited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work with award-winning production teams
rubrics_metrics.description: "Our innovative team has garnered more than 100 awards for live action video, 2D and 3D animation, motion graphics and PSA production."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer experienced/recognized creative teams to ensure polished output and creative excellence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local, global and bilingual production capability
rubrics_metrics.description: "Go as local or global as you want... We can even produce content for bilingual audiences."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan shoots and localization based on target markets; support multiple locations and bilingual productions to reach diverse audience segments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage and refresh existing multimedia assets
rubrics_metrics.description: "We’re experts at refreshing existing video content with audio-only sound bites, or with new content captured with traditional or remote filming methods."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repurpose previously created content (e.g., create social clips, audio bites) to maximize ROI rather than always creating new footage from scratch.

rubrics_metrics.name: End-to-end, full-service production approach
rubrics_metrics.description: "We handle every step of the production process, from concepts and storyboards to the shooting, video editing and other post-production."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the vendor/producer covers concepting, storyboarding, filming, editing, motion graphics, and post-production to maintain quality and consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speed and reach via Satellite, Radio and Virtual Media Tours (VMT)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Virtual Media Tours let your spokesperson reach a large audience quickly—with back-to-back television, radio, or online interviews ... in a single day."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use VMTs to rapidly amplify events, launches or campaigns; customize tours to prioritize target markets and use satellite/Zoom/Skype to avoid travel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media-relations expertise and execution volume
rubrics_metrics.description: "Our team produces more than 200 media tours every year."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select vendors with proven media-relations experience and a track record of delivering tours/pitches at scale for better placement and coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create repurposable follow-on content
rubrics_metrics.description: "Every engagement includes production of a generic interview you can repurpose in subsequent marketing and PR efforts."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Require deliverables that can be reused across channels (generic interviews, cutdowns) to extend the life and ROI of media engagements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optional talent procurement for spokespersons
rubrics_metrics.description: "If you need a spokesperson, we'll find and contract with the right one through our extensive talent agent partnerships."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider procuring professional on-air talent through agency relationships when client lacks a suitable spokesperson.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social video optimization and distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: "Social Video Distribution... transforms your existing content... into a compelling, social media-optimized video that's guaranteed to drive more views and greater engagement on Facebook and Instagram."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format and edit videos specifically for target social platforms (length, aspect ratio, captions) to maximize engagement and platform performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event production and teleconferencing expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: "Whether you need teleconferencing expertise to support an earnings call, an experienced producer for your next webcast, or a skilled team to broadcast your event on Facebook Live—our event production team will ensure a professional presentation..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use professional technical and production support for webcasts, live broadcasts, and virtual events to ensure flawless delivery and audience experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multichannel News Release (MNR) packaging
rubrics_metrics.description: "A Multichannel News Release (MNR) combines your press release and up to 6 multimedia assets—video, images, audio and more—into a single, Cision-created and hosted, branded landing page experience focused on your story and message."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Package narrative and multiple multimedia assets into a single branded landing page to create a unified, sharable storytelling hub.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution reach and guaranteed local broadcast placements
rubrics_metrics.description: "Distribution of your content across PR Newswire’s industry-leading extensive audience generating network, including full national wire transmission to thousands of websites, media outlets, and journalists, with guaranteed placement on 200 local broadcast media websites via Cision-exclusive partnerships."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate distribution networks for national wire reach plus any guaranteed local broadcast placements to ensure visibility in target markets.

rubrics_metrics.name: International extension and influencer opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: "Opportunities to extend promotion of your content to international outlets and influencers."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan optional outreach to international press and influencers to broaden campaign reach beyond domestic audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guaranteed landing page views metric
rubrics_metrics.description: "10,000 landing page views, guaranteed"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Require clear, contractual guarantees for minimum landing-page views when purchasing MNR packages and evaluate fulfillment/reporting methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead generation features included
rubrics_metrics.description: "Lead generation features that drive traffic to your website and social media channels"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include forms, CTAs, tracking and other lead-gen mechanisms on the landing page to convert traffic to measurable leads.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platform posting of video assets
rubrics_metrics.description: "Posting of one video to YouTube, Vimeo or the video portal of your choice"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure at least one video is posted to an appropriate public video platform as part of distribution to increase discoverability and hosting reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: MNR Pro: paid native placement and guaranteed impressions
rubrics_metrics.description: "MNR Pro adds paid placement of your press release as a native article on relevant websites, and native ads promoting the article on other high-traffic pages... guaranteed publication and 150K guaranteed impressions on the web sites your target audiences follow and trust."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use paid native placements and impression guarantees to secure placement on trusted sites and reach a larger, targeted web audience; verify targeting and reporting details.

rubrics_metrics.name: MNR Interactive: interactive experiences to increase engagement and data collection
rubrics_metrics.description: "MNR Interactive transforms your news into engaging quizzes, flip-books, ‘live’ charts and more. Your audience will spend more time with your news, and you’ll gather more data on the information and experiences that interest them most"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add interactive elements (quizzes, live charts, flip-books) to increase dwell time and collect richer audience interaction data for insights and retargeting.

rubrics_metrics.name: MNR Deluxe: combine multimedia, paid placement, and interactivity
rubrics_metrics.description: "MNR Deluxe combines all our MNR options—branded multimedia landing page, paid placement, and interactive content—into a single seamless experience that keeps influencers, journalists, customers, and prospects engaged from start to finish."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use an all-in-one package when seeking maximum engagement across channels and formats; combines guaranteed reach, interactive elements, and paid amplification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use MNR as a shareable pitching tool
rubrics_metrics.description: "MNRs get your content greater visibility with your target audience, and more social media engagement from influencers and customers. It elevates your press release to a powerful, sharable pitching tool."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design MNR landing pages and assets to be easily sharable with influencers and on social channels to extend earned media opportunities.
